_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG113 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.plan_basis: second pass over what pass 1 left. Two identified blocks come out of the residual; the legal material after them stays, because it is at least two works and neither is settled here.
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG113.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG113.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG113.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.

works.title: Synecdemus
works.evidence: 8 rows, 1,600 tokens. Locus 82 opens with the work's own display title, ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΙΚΟΥ. ΣΥΝΕΚΛΗΜΟΣ., and the text is the Synecdemus end to end: numbered provinces each with a governor's rank and a city count, Αʹ Ἐπαρχία Θρᾴκης Εὐρώπης ... πόλεις ιδʹ through ΝΘʹ Ἐπαρχία Αὐγούστα at 89. No TLG anchor is claimed: the vendored Canon has no Synecdemus and no record for this Hierocles at all. Its two Hierocles entries are other men, tlg1429 the Stoic (Ἠθικὴ στοιχείωσις, Fragmenta ap. Stobaeum) and tlg2571 the Neoplatonist (In aureum carmen), and the corpus already serves both. The author slug is new for that reason and follows the OCR's own ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΙΚΟΥ.

works.title: Narratio de imagine Edessena
works.evidence: 15 rows, 5,761 tokens against the Canon's 6,032 words for tlg3023.013, a ratio of 0.96. Locus 223 carries the work's title in Greek capitals, ΚΩΝΣΤΑΝΤΙΝΟΥ ... ΒΑΣΙΛΕΩΣ ΡΩΜΑΙΩΝ ΔΙΗΓΗΣΙΣ ἀπὸ διαφόρων ἀθροισθεῖσα ἱστοριῶν, περὶ τῆς πρὸς Αὔγαρον ἀποσταλείσης ... θείας εἰκόνος, καὶ ὡς ἐξ Ἐδέσσης μετεκομίσθη, and the narrative runs through the Saracen negotiation, the healing, and the image's entry into Constantinople in procession. Nothing in the corpus is anchored to tlg3023.013, so this carves primary.

residual.note: 238-313 is legal, and it is NOT one work. A Latin running head ΚΟΜΑΝΟΚΟΜ ΙΜΡΡ. ... ΛΕΩΟΜ ΟΟΜΡΕΝΡΙΑΚΙΟΘ (ROMANORUM IMPP. ... LEGUM COMPENDIARIUS) opens at locus 238 character 571, a title list runs from 241 (ΤΙΤΛΟΣ ΠΡΩΤΟΣ beside its garbled Latin ΤΙΤΗΙΗΘ ΡΗΙΜΙΘ), and by 313 the text is imperial Novellae (ΠΒʹ. Νεαρὰ Κωνσταντίνου ἡ ἀποκειμένη ἐν τῇ σακέλλῃ). Where the compendium ends and the Novellae begin is not established here, so carving it as one work would file two things under one name. 328-489 and the short 318-323 runs are not researched.

corrections_mirror_note: data/corrections_log/applied.jsonl keys this volume's corrections by bare column locus under cogPG.PG113; per the rekey_corrections_log.py convention for cogPG.* bare-locus rows they are left unchanged (historical). The locus map above makes the linkage reconstructable.
